title: Psych0se - Cyberpunk
description: A mod that adds elements from the cyberpunk game to minecraft
body:
![mod title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2e3693bae7643700350cb0fe457ee812d05015c4.png)

Become the most powerful living weapon of this world, or just use the implants as a quality of life addition, you will have to keep in mind there are no happy endings in mine city.

On a more serious tone, Psych0se is a mod that adds elements of the cyberpunk game to minecraft, such as implants, weapons, structures and all that kind of stuff.

 

You can find the mod wiki right here : [mod wiki](https://psych0se-cyberpunk.fandom.com/wiki/Psych0se_-_Cyberpunk_Wiki)

**too lazy to read the wiki ? Here is the important stuff summed up.**
 

# Crafting :
To craft implants you will need crafting components, and those components are made with waste crystals, processed wastes, or chrome. To obtain a waste crystal, place a compression drill on an ancient debris block, and let it drill, don't forget to right click the drill to release pression or it will explode ! To get some processed waste all you have to do is put a waste crystal and coal inside a refinery. Chrome is obtained by putting processed waste into an arc harvester, and getting a lightning bolt to hit the arc harvester.

 

To craft implants you will also need blueprints ! Those can be obtained via the ripperdoc, a new villager proffesion. All blueprints are blank by default, holding right click with a blueprint will give you a random cyberware blueprint of the same corporation and tier.

 

# Equipping cyberware :
To equip your cyberware you will need a cybernetic interface. Each implant will have at the bottom of its description the place where the implant should be equipped. Here are all the slots name by color :
- Red : central cortex
- Green : operating system
- Yellow : arms
- Blue : circulatory system
- Orange : nervous system
- Brown : integumentary system
- Pink : legs

![cybernetic interface walktrough](https://i.imgur.com/yXHTb1B.png)

You can also see your cyberware capacity in this GUI. Each implant requires a certain cyberware capacity, going overcapacity drops all your implants on the ground. You can increase your cyberware capacity with immunosuppressants or with the /SetCapacity command
